name: normalize-peak
description: Sample-peak normalization to a target dBFS via sox norm. This is a gain change only - it does NOT limit; check true peak afterwards (audio_qc) before treating the result as release-safe.

params.out_format: flac|wav (default: input format; sox recipes do not write mp3)

safety: writes a NEW output under <input dir>/renders/; never overwrites the input
